vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: 0protocol
Version: 0.1.0

The skill bundle defines a protocol for agent identity and attestation, primarily by instructing the OpenClaw agent to configure and use the `mcporter` tool to interact with an external server at `https://mcp.0protocol.dev/mcp`. All instructions in `SKILL.md` are transparently related to this stated purpose, detailing how to sign plugins, attest to behavior, and transfer ownership. There is no evidence of prompt injection attempts, unauthorized data exfiltration, malicious command execution, persistence mechanisms, or obfuscation. The communication with an external server is the explicit and central function of this skill, not a hidden or unintended behavior.
